question: What claim about the status of this teaching must hold if it is said to be the supreme secret of secrets, revealed to the addressee by devotion?
premises: This is the supreme secret among secrets.
It has been revealed to the addressee by devotion.
inference: The teaching is a supreme secret, disclosed specifically to the devoted addressee.
uncertainties: The agent of revelation is not named in this verse.
plain_english: The supreme secret of secrets has been revealed to you by devotion.
